body: Part of #193 Project 1's official `.hdl` / `.tst` / `.cmp` text now lives in `conformance/vectors/01/`. `scripts/sync-vectors.sh` clones https://github.com/nand2tetris/web-ide.git at `52611ad9bc2a30d329293b0cf58be672d672ac96` (Release 2026.19.0) and extracts the TypeScript string modules. The notice in `conformance/vectors/LICENSE` records that commit and the licence that covers the text: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (Nisan and Schocken / nand2tetris.org). web-ide's MIT licence does not cover these files, and neither does HACER's. `conformance/vectors/**` warns in pr-hygiene (flag, not a failing gate). A test locks the 16 hand-transcribed fixtures to the vendored files. Projects 2–5 are follow-ups, so this does not close #193. #151 still owns the sticky tamper comment for the rest of the protected-path list. Model: Grok 4.7 Reviewable lines: 251 (warn over 200, under the 400 budget; vectors and tests excluded). ### Definition of done All exit 0 in the worktree: - `pnpm run lint` — typecheck, eslint, layer ratchet (72 known, 0 new), e2e-dead-exports 0 - `pnpm run test:run` — 142 files, 2305 tests passed - `pnpm run build` — vite build succeeded - `pnpm run lint:docs` — clean - `ls conformance/vectors/01 | wc -l` — 48 ### Docs sync (author) Living-doc rows touched: `REPO_MAP.md`, `docs/decisions/0021`. Roadmap, README, `.cursorrules`, and `HACER_LLM_GUIDE.md` are N/A — new oracle path, not a phase or stack change. ### Tests added - `scripts/sync-vectors.logic.test.mjs` — pin, chip extraction, licence notice, the 16 fixtures match the vendored files - `scripts/protected-paths.logic.test.mjs` — `conformance/vectors/**` is protected - `scripts/pr-hygiene.logic.test.mjs` — touching the oracle warns and does not fail the check ### Deviation The filed criterion said copy from `../web-ide`. The 2026-09-23 comment replaces that with a pinned public clone. This PR vendors Project 1 only, per the same issue's earlier comment. ### Open CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 includes NonCommercial. The notice records that; it does not ask the rights holders for a commercial grant.
